Section 61 in Chapter VII of the Mulla's Principles of Mohamedan ·
Law, edited by M. Hidayatullah, former Chief Justice of this Court, postu-lates three classes of heirs, name]y2 . (1) sharers,(2) residuaries, and (3)
B distant kindred. Sharers are those who are entitled to a prescribed share
in inheritance; residuaries are those who take no prescribed share, but
succeed to the 'residue' after the claims of the shares are satisfied; and
distant kindred are all those relations by blood who are neither sharers nor
residuaries. The Table at page 72-A of th.e 18th Edition prescribes that a
C father who is under Item No. 1, gets 1/6th share, where there is child or
children of a son; and when there is no child or children of a son, the father
inherits as residuary. Since Sabul Hassan left behind D-4 son, Isabul Ali
